text.p: Following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- World Bank enters debate over East Asia's economic growth prospects beyond 8 percent.
- China no longer cares whether it joins the World Trade Organisation.
- Intel Corp develops world's fastest supercomputer, capable of performing one trillion operations a second.
- Tamil Tiger guerillas assassinate top field commander of elite Sri Lankan commando unit.
- Singapore's top 1,000 companies tend to be multinational corporations and listed conglomerates.
- Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Barrick Gold Corp agree on 22.5-67.5 percent split of huge Busang gold find in East Kalimantan province.
- Malaysia logs trade deficit of 773.4 million ringgit in October.
- Pidemco Land plans to enter luxury condominium sector with projects in Singapore's prime residential districts.
- Dow Jones Industrial Average down 1.9 as market awaits Fed move on interest rates.
- Wooden door manufacturer Chuan Soon Huat to list on main board within the first two months of next year.
- Singapore Land stock up 4.5 percent to Singapore $8.20 on Merrill Lynch report.
- Listed Thakral Corporation Ltd announces it will be acquiring the 430-room Hilton on the Park Hotel in Melbourne for Australian $59 million.
- Gold Peak group unit GPE Industries posts 18.8 percent rise in interim net profit to Singapore $6.7 million.
- Watch retailer and distributor The Hour Glass suffers 49.7 percent slide in interim net profit to Singapore $2.54 million for six months ended September 30.
